'''2012 Bespin Regionals Mark Walseth DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mark Walseth]] at [[2012 Bespin Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
